description: Calculates final velocity using the kinematic equation: v = v₀ + at, where v₀ is initial velocity, a is acceleration, and t is time. (cost: 1 credit)

acceleration.description: number, required, acceleration, meters per second squared, no default

initial_velocity.description: number, required, starting velocity, meters per second, no default

time.description: number, required, time elapsed, seconds, no default

name: calculate_final_velocity
